AquaSense

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 22, 2026

This policy explains how AquaSense handles information when you use the aquarium monitoring service.

Information the service handles

  • Account information: email address, account identifier, and sign-in provider details needed to authenticate you. Passwords and OAuth sign-in are handled by Supabase Auth and the provider you choose.
  • Aquarium information: aquarium names and settings, temperature and pH readings, device identifiers, alerts, care tasks, and reports associated with an aquarium.
  • Security and operation records: limited administrator audit events and device-ingestion status events used to secure and troubleshoot the service.

How information is used

AquaSense uses this information to sign you in, display aquarium readings and care information, operate sensor ingestion, maintain platform security, and troubleshoot failures. Aquarium information is available to the account owner and authorized AquaSense administrators under the configured access controls.

Service providers and sharing

AquaSense uses Supabase for authentication, database, and application services. If you choose Google or Facebook sign-in, that provider processes your authentication according to its own privacy policy. AquaSense does not ask you to share your provider password with AquaSense. Information is not sold. It may be processed by these providers to deliver the service or disclosed when required by law.

Retention and security

Account and aquarium records are retained while needed to provide the service and administer the platform. Access controls are used to limit account access, but no internet service can guarantee absolute security. Backups and provider systems may retain information for a limited period under their own retention practices.

Your choices

You can stop using AquaSense and ask the administrator who manages your account to remove your account or aquarium information. See the data deletion instructions. You can also use email/password sign-in instead of an optional social sign-in provider where available.

Changes and questions

This policy may be updated as AquaSense changes. For privacy questions, contact the AquaSense administrator who manages your account.
